# Generated speech fixtures

These WAVs contain no human microphone recordings or saved user voiceprints.
They were generated by `research/generate-attribution-fixtures.ps1` using Windows
System.Speech Microsoft Hazel and Microsoft Zira voices, mono PCM16 at 16 kHz.
The original test phrases are in that script. `voice-a-profile.wav` uses different
words from `voice-a-speech.wav`; `voice-b-speech.wav` says the same held-out phrase
with the other generated voice. These exercise integration, not human accuracy.
They are test inputs only and are not copied to the published site.

`voice-a-stop.wav` was generated with the same Hazel/PCM16 settings and the phrase
“Command stop.” for the microphone lifecycle test.
